title: SSE Event Envelope
description: Normalized SSE events emitted by the Spring Boot proxy after rewrapping the orchestrator's raw text stream into JSON. Canonical contract surface — do not restate inline in playbooks or guides (R5).

ConversationIdEvent.description: Conversation identifier. Emitted at most once, before the first chunk. Carries the persistent conversation id used for follow-up requests. JSON Schema cannot express stream ordering structurally; this constraint is enforced by integration tests, not by the schema.

value.description: Conversation id (typically a UUID-shaped opaque token). Required.

ChunkEvent.description: Streaming text fragment of the assistant's response. Emitted zero or more times in order between conversationId and done.

text.description: Text fragment. May be empty but must be present.

CitationEvent.description: Citation surfaced by the orchestrator (e.g., from Bing Grounding or AI Search). Emitted zero or more times, interleaved with chunk events.

url.description: Citation URL (must be a syntactically valid URI).

DoneEvent.description: Stream terminator. Emitted exactly once at the end of a successful stream. No payload fields.

ErrorEvent.description: Terminal failure event. Emitted at most once, replacing 'done'. Carries a stable error code and a human-readable message.

code.description: Stable error code (e.g., UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT, AUTH_DENIED). Implementations should treat unknown codes as opaque.

message.description: Human-readable error message. May contain sanitized diagnostic info.
